text.line.m.a1.05.bout: Ring is set! Two rounds, no weapons, the crowd decides.
text.line.m.a1.05.lose: You went down swinging. The crowd respects that.
text.line.m.a1.05.start: Saint here. The turntable at Powell and Market is open tonight. Come see what the Chorus is building.
text.line.m.a1.05.talk.signup.open: Welcome to the turntable! Folks are signing up for an exhibition bout. Want a spot?
text.line.m.a1.05.win: That is how it is done! The Chorus will remember you.
text.line.m.a1.05.ring.1: The turntable turns, the crowd closes in. Ladies and gentlemen, the ring is open.
text.mission.m.a1.05.obj.wait_crowd: Wait for the crowd to close in
text.mission.m.a1.05.talk.signup.intent: Sign up for the exhibition bout
text.mission.m.a1.05.title: Turntable Battle
